recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-16996 unless the work group later decides to redesign ElementDefinition mapping presentation; FHIR-20502 already handled the later field-name terminology correction.
issue_request: FHIR-16996 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ElementDefinition. It objected that ElementDefinition.requirements was mapped to LOINC R/O/C even though the element records rationale/traceability, and asked why ElementDefinition LOINC mappings appeared inline rather than on the mappings page. The approved resolution was to make the mapping clearer and add a section or reference about the relationship between LOINC, ElementDefinition, and ObservationDefinition.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 14327. In git history, commit 1147638b97b47c53569b2b2f2905ad24568f89e5 removed the R/O/C LOINC mapping from ElementDefinition.requirements in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and added introductory ElementDefinition mappings-page guidance, including the LOINC/ObservationDefinition relationship.
additional_context: ElementDefinition remains an active datatype and type page in source/fhir.ini. Later same-family issue FHIR-20502 refined the LOINC terminology from code to field name and is already represented on the combined branch by commit ad43174a61952b63ba1e18541b6dab01829d7d22. FHIR-I minutes for 2018-07-09 record FHIR-16996 in the approved block vote, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source labels the relevant column and mapping-space metadata as LOINC Field Name, explains on source/elementdefinition-mappings.html that the values are LOINC table field names rather than LOINC term codes, and leaves ElementDefinition.requirements without a LOINC field-name mapping.
